34. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT
The Board’s policy is to maintain a strong capital base so as to maintain investor, creditor and market confidence and to sustain
future development of the business. The Board of Directors monitors the return on capital, which the Company defines as result
from operating activities divided by total shareholders’ equity, excluding non controlling interests. The Board of Directors also
monitors the level of dividends to ordinary shareholders.
